The customer service is just awful!! I’ve been ordering and playing the puppy keep for years. I don’t have a problem with the merchandise at all. 
I do however have a problem with the Puppy Keep game. Myself and people I had sign up have been ripped off, ignored and sent automated messages. I know how to play the game and they tell me I did something wrong instead of just fixing the problem!! All I asked is for them to give me the prize I picked and not the lousy credit they switched it too. 
Absolutely terrible treatment!!

data.review_body:
I bought a big order some time ago.
This order came in two lots but I realised certain items were not there 
I went back into Shein and I couldn’t find my order details it will only show a selection of what I ordered. I went into my basket and approx six to seven items are still in my basket. I queried this with them as I paid for the whole order. I received no answer so queried again and then numerous times since
I have still received no communication from them.
As such I will never shop with them again and that was before these new charges, but there is approx €30 sitting in my basket that I never received but paid for. My next step is to report it to my bank. Very disappointed and as it was all holiday stuff I had to replace everything somewhere else. Terrible costumer service.

data.review_body:
Stop writing template messages, give me my money back, I paid for the warranty?!!!


Your employee sent me a so-called "resolution" asking me to return the items, but this is NOT a real solution. I specifically paid extra for your Return Assurance / Shipping Guarantee to ensure a hassle-free process, yet your team has created endless problems instead of protecting my purchase. As I already stated, a physical return from Azerbaijan to your Dubai hub is legally and logistically impossible for a private citizen due to strict international customs regulations, regardless of who pays for shipping. Your automated system continues to reject my clear, high-quality photos on a uniform background. Since your team ignores the paid guarantee, refuses to issue a direct refund for your own warehouse error, and offers impossible return options, I have already escalated this to an external consumer protection platform and my next step today is contacting my bank to initiate a forced chargeback. Order GSH17R33N00NS4B requires an immediate manual refund without return!
data.review_headline: Warehouse error & ignored paid guarantee — Order GSH17R33N00NS4B
